title: Situational Irony — The Opposite of What You Think
skills: identify contrasts between expectation and outcome
analyze how situational irony creates surprise or meaning
explain how irony contributes to theme and author's craft
alignment_note: Explains situational irony as a contrast between what is expected to happen and what actually occurs. Supports close reading, analysis of surprise and reversal, interpretation of theme, and understanding of author's craft across high school English courses.
